name: scheduled-work
description: Scheduled-work / reminder tracking for autonomous agents. Records background-queue work items and lets a REMINDER re-verify uncertain/blocked/overdue work before an agent reports it done (§11.4.6 / §11.4.108). Wraps the decoupled scheduled-work-engine Go MCP server (REST + MCP over HTTP/3 + brotli, plus MCP/ACP over stdio).
